subject: Welcome — schedule your Redwood Inference demo
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aliya Singh <aliya@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Welcome — schedule your Redwood Inference demo

Hi Aliya,

Thanks for signing up to try Redwood Inference — excited to show you how our inference platform can reduce latency and cost for your vector search pipeline. We run short, focused demos (~20 minutes) that cover: high-level architecture, live demo on a sample dataset, and next steps for a pilot.

Pick a time that works for you: https://cal.redwood.com/mk/20min (link auto-detects your timezone). If you prefer a longer technical session (30–45m) or need specific teammates invited, reply with names and we’ll hand off to an engineer.

Quick pre-demo ask (helps us tailor the session): what are the top two goals you want to accomplish in the demo?

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-demo-playbook.pdf (pdf)
From: Aliya Singh <aliya@acme.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 11:05:14 -0500
Subject: Re: Welcome — schedule your Redwood Inference demo

Hi Markus,

Thanks — I clicked the link but only saw 11a and later PST slots; our team is mostly on ET. Is there any chance for an earlier window (between 9–11am ET) this week? Also, would it be possible to expand to 30 minutes — we want to walk through a quick overview of our current infra and a couple of latency-sensitive queries.

I attached a short doc with integration notes.

Best,
Aliya
Head of Search, Acme Corp
attachment: integration_requirements.docx
